responseText: Some Historian of the Scholars Academy paid the Cloaks to swipe it from my pouch, a wizard named Krudd the Chronicler. Well, Krudd the dud is most likely casing the ruins, hoping to get a crack at the riches beneath. If I were you, I'd forget the whole thing.
